description: The deposit provides raw and curated inputs, processing files, code and figure outputs for a study of policy-aware hydrogen refuelling infrastructure planning. Its description separates raw data, intermediate results, curated data, scripts and figures. The provider is JAdE-Wang66. Coverage: The public description does not specify the city, country, time period or spatial resolution of the study. Those fields must remain unconfirmed. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: The metadata describe the authors’ work; they do not independently establish accuracy, completeness or reproducibility. For simulation it can support reproduction of the associated infrastructure-planning analysis once documentation and input provenance are checked. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
